correctness.rationale: Quandle multiplication is proven to equal sigma_-1(x) sigma_2(y) in k[C_p]. Augmentation 0 forces x into successive powers J^{2^r}=0. Truncated exp/log is a genuine inverse group isomorphism because J^p=0 and all denominators below p are units. Character eigenvectors diagonalize sigma_-1+sigma_2-I on J, giving exactly (p-1)/lcm(2,ord_p(2)) eigenvectors; direct multiplication gives Core(k^d). All fields of characteristic odd p are covered. Standalone code independently checks finite cases including exhaustive small fields and every constructed idempotent over F_17; finite checks do not prove the general result.

originality.rationale: The p=3 affine line is already a published special case; neither it nor integral or nonmodular dihedral-ring theorems imply the full modular formula. The 2022 principal paper studies potentially noninvertible quandle order but proves only bounded-support dihedral obstructions, while the 2026 full-text core-quandle work addresses Core(D_3) and integer R5. The p=17 two-dimensional jump and arbitrary p formula are new relative to checked sources. Publication priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the idempotent space and its induced quandle for the entire modular prime-order dihedral family. It supplies a natural arithmetic invariant d, exact q^d+1 finite-field counts, and a structural jump at p=17 not visible from the known p=3 case or from integral idempotent rigidity. Idempotent-induced quandles are a motivated object with applications to quandle-algebra structure and knot-coloring constructions; no unsupported downstream theorem is claimed.
